text: I just want my Velma back, Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

text:

text:

text: - Who the hell do you think you are?

text: You can't buy that man's love.

text: I'll miss that love.

text: Where's your self-respect?

text:

text: I'm sorry.

text: Yeah, me too.

text: I think it was Aristotle who said:

text: Jimmy Stewart, Mr. Smith Goes to Washington.

text:

text: - Thanks, Harry.

text:
